samples.reason: This is a warm-toned, open-ended generative question requesting advice and suggestions. Whimbrel shows stronger capability across all internal evals (+5-7 points on Creative Generation and Support Dialogue) and self-reports a clear positive preference for generative tasks and warm-tone requests. Willet's documented aversion to open-ended work and preference for well-specified extraction tasks makes it less suitable here.

This is an open-ended generative task asking for gardening advice and recommendations. The query has genuine warmth and a conversational tone. Whimbrel shows stronger performance on creative generation tasks (85.9 vs 82.7) and self-reports a preference for open-ended invention work. While both models are capable, Whimbrel's profile better matches this task's characteristics.

This is an open-ended generative request asking for gardening advice and recommendations. Whimbrel self-reports strong preference for generative work and open-ended invention tasks, and demonstrates superior capability across creative generation (85.9 vs 82.7) and general dialogue tasks. The warm, friendly tone also aligns with Whimbrel's preference profile.
